items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had the opportunity to sit in with him quite a few times. And not – I say quite a few times, but it was probably three, four times.

ctx.x: [Back to Harris] So, in what other kind of ways would you say Charlie Parker affected your life? The music…

Just playing, that’s all. [laughs] No, he was more than that, man. I had the opportunity to sit in with him quite a few times. And not – I say quite a few times, but it was probably three, four times. And he always was beautiful, you know. I felt the same – I also felt that kind of beauty when it came to Gene Harris ‘cause he would let me sit in all the time, too.
So, I’ve read some things where some people have said that Mr. Parker was a – not a kind gentleman, but you didn’t have that kind of experience with him.
